title: 10 quart wash basin buckets
text: 10 quart wash basin buckets. I bought these to set my long handled cleaning scrub brushes in after use.  They are the perfect size and depth.  I also set cleaners in with the brush. I have them in a bathroom closet in one portion of the house and to the side and behind the toilet in another bathroom. The edges are "rolled" as shown in the pics, so they are smooth, not sharp where you have contact with them.  Super easy to clean when necessary too.  I can see where these could be used in several different ways.  Well worth it.  They are what I would consider a medium thickness or medium duty... not super thin, however, not heavy and thick.  They arrived quickly (i have prime) and in excellent shape along with other things I had ordered.
